[[Stygian Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] dropped by the [[Stygian Underlord (ranger)]], a [[boss]] that can be found in the [[Stygian Veil]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Plagueborn Recurve Bow]] [[dye]]d red.
